source_note: Verified Physics Form One scheme of work for Term I (TIE curriculum). 14 weeks: Introduction to Physics (Weeks 1-2), Measurement (Weeks 3-5), Introduction to Force (Weeks 6-8), Density and Relative Density (Weeks 9, 11), Sinking and Floating (Weeks 12-14). Week 10 is mid-term assessment and break. 4 periods per week (two 80-min double periods).
